instruction: An industrial gate valve: a central body with two bolted flanges on either side (with bolt-hole rings), a raised spindle housing (bonnet) on top, a rising stem, and a round spoked handwheel at the top. Cast-metal engineering look.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a industrial gate valve. An industrial gate valve: a central body with two bolted flanges on either side (with bolt-hole rings), a raised spindle housing (bonnet) on top, a rising stem, and a round spoked handwheel at the top. Cast-metal engineering look. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
